name: LITTLEPROUD, the Hon. David Kelly

headline.note: Official parliamentary records establish cotton chipping in 1993 and banking/finance from 1994 to 2016. Employer and industry sources divide the banking career between NAB and Suncorp and identify senior agribusiness roles, while parliamentary interests and first-person statements establish a Warwick rental business. None of the sources publishes full-time status, exact payroll boundaries, leave or the relationship between business ownership and operational work. Party positions and elected office are excluded. Missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography and 2017 Parliamentary Handbook record cotton chipping in 1993. Employer, location, seasonal dates, hours and continuity are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: A year label for seasonal agricultural labour does not establish a full-time interval.

career_spells.role: Agribusiness and commercial banking roles; district manager in Warwick
career_spells.evidence_note: Official records give an overall 1994–2016 banking-and-finance interval. Employer and industry profiles report 17 years at NAB, including 12 years in Warwick as district manager for agribusiness and commercial banking, before joining Suncorp in 2011. Exact appointment and cessation dates, earlier role sequence, hours and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: The long private-sector interval is well supported, but full-time status and exact boundaries are not.

career_spells.role: Executive Manager, Business and Agribusiness Banking, South West Queensland
career_spells.evidence_note: Industry and event biographies report that Littleproud joined Suncorp in 2011 as executive manager for South West Queensland. Official records place the end of his banking-and-finance career in 2016, and an industry report says he left banking after winning preselection/election. Exact commencement, cessation, leave and campaign arrangements are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: A senior title does not by itself establish continuous full-time service, and the election transition is only year-bounded.

career_spells.employer: Mr Rental Southern Downs Pty Ltd trading as Mr Rentals Southern Downs
career_spells.evidence_note: Littleproud's official site identifies business ownership in Warwick. His 2016 interests register records a shareholding in Mr Rental Southern Downs Pty Ltd and his spouse's wage from the company. In 2017 Hansard he described himself as a former retail small-business owner, while 2018 reporting and a speech described current ownership and four employees. These sources establish ownership but leave his operational hours, commencement, cessation and overlap with banking/elected office unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Ownership is not automatically substantive full-time employment; no countable operating interval is established.

career_spells.role: Chair, Maranoa Divisional Council and Southern Downs Electorate Council
career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary records list both party positions but do not supply dates, paid status, hours or overlap with business and banking work.
Official parliamentary service begins with the 2 July 2016 federal election.
